performers.description: The eight playable puppets: skills, stage fright, roles, flaws, voices.

staff.description: Madame, the three Quills, Clipboard, Mrs. Gasket and the paper moon: the agents who talk but do not perform.

flaws.description: Character flaws: what sets each one off (tag triggers), how often, and which mishap kinds it causes.

mishaps.description: Everything that goes wrong on stage: one tiny story per mishap, with effects, calamity slug and animation.

whispers.description: The Prompter's three whispers for every mishap kind (Yes and / Cover it up / a third way).

cues.description: The six stage cues (lights, thunder, trapdoor, fog, spotlight, curtain): what they fit, and how they misfire.

genres.description: Five genres x five beats x 5-6 script variants: loglines, tags, props and dialogue.

towns.description: Thirty towns with tastes, expectations, landmarks and gossip (plus the Royal Opera House of Wibbling).

tastes.description: Twelve audience archetypes: hat, likes, hates and how readily they laugh, cry, gasp and boo.

critics.description: Five pigeon critics: what they weigh, how noisy they are, and their star-rated pull-quote templates.

playbill.description: Programme furniture: bio parts, headings, back-page filler, 'tonight in' and 'previously' lines.

road_events.description: Twenty things that happen on the road between towns, with choices and consequences.

almanac_seeds.description: Sixty legends that seed the Almanac of Calamities so it has lore from night one.

props.description: Thirty props: names, the tags they imply, and the sprite that draws them.

shows_gold.description: Regression ground truth: seeded shows with autopilot and expected star bands (generated by the engine).
